description: Generate a financial report for a building. summary.outstanding is overdue debt as of endDate, from the same calculation as analyze_debts_and_generate_reminders. Monthly dues are due on the building's dues day (duesDueDay in building settings, 10 unless changed), so the current month is dueSoon until that day has passed. Dates follow the building's time zone.
name: generate_financial_report
title: Financial report
